title: Nudge a client about an estimate

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: A client has your estimate and has gone quiet. One click sends them a reminder.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open the client. Here, Luis Orozco.

steps.caption: Sent and opened, not answered
steps.narration: Under Estimates, his estimate was sent and opened, but he has not answered.

steps.caption: Remind
steps.narration: Remind is on every sent estimate that is still waiting for an answer.

steps.caption: Reminder recorded
steps.narration: The CRM confirms it. An email went out, and a text as well.

steps.caption: The text goes to their mobile
steps.narration: The text goes to the mobile number on the client's page.

steps.caption: The client opens the email
steps.narration: Now your client's screen. The reminder email has a button that opens the estimate.

steps.caption: The same estimate
steps.narration: It is the same estimate, with its total.

steps.caption: Ready to approve
steps.narration: They can read it again, and approve it from this page.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, you can remind again any time the estimate is still open.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Remind is on the client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: How to remind a client about an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: When a client goes quiet on an estimate, send a reminder from the ConstructHUB CRM in one click. The client gets an email, and a text when texting is set up, with a link back to the estimate. Recorded in a demo workspace; no real message is sent.
